title: MonitorLatency-Bench: Benchmarking the Speed-Accuracy Trade-off in AI Monitoring

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: deployers making real decisions about monitoring need to know the speed-accuracy trade-off. Establishing latency as a first-class metric would shift the field toward more practical monitoring research. Immediately actionable for deployment decisions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing or obtaining 3-4 different monitors, running them on SHADE-Arena tasks, measuring both detection AUC and per-step latency. Setting up SHADE-Arena infrastructure and running multiple monitors requires significant engineering work beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple monitors to implement/configure, SHADE-Arena infrastructure setup, dual measurement (accuracy and latency), Pareto frontier analysis, and a blog post. Substantial scope for 30 hours, especially for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
